concerns.text: FR-001 requires ingestion from NIST Chemistry WebBook *and* Materials Project. The only ingestion task (T005) streams the Polymer Genome dataset and Materials Project API, omitting NIST as a source, so the functional requirement is not fully covered.

FR-011 restricts data sources to NIST Chemistry WebBook and Materials Project (plus the curated external set). The task list uses the Polymer Genome dataset, which is not an allowed source, leaving this requirement uncovered.
FR-020 calls for a NetworkX PNG visualization of the top 5 degradation pathways with associated motifs. No task in tasks.md creates or validates such a visualization.
FR-021 requires an ablation study training the GNN without any synthetically labeled records. No task in tasks.md implements or evaluates this ablation.
SC-006 demands reporting an ingestion success rate of ≥ 95 %. No task records or verifies this metric; the closest task (T005) only checks for file existence and row count.
SC-009 specifies that data‑augmentation must complete within 30 minutes and that this runtime be measured. No task includes a timing check or asserts the 30‑minute limit.
